bundles.notes: Baseline bundle baked into APK 0.1.1-test (versionCode 2). Current live snapshot: Fix Round 1 engine, original music, new title art, mazed routes, 509 re-sliced walk sheets, fixed tile 61.
Identical to 2026.11.01-1 (current snapshot) plus a visible 'OTA v2' title-screen marker.

Fix Round 2: gym 4-8 + Champion page-condition fix (game completable again), Route 2 battleback restored, full Mart/Dept Store stocks, gyms 4-8 award badges, evolution stones respect type, Mach Bike refuses indoors, Dex totals /504, daycare compatibility + walking egg. Marker 'OTA v3'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass A: unified stat model for player + wilds + trainers (one formula from species base stats), base stats normalized by evolution stage (36 species), all damage formulas rescaled (avg turns-to-KO ~3.6 at Lv50), EXP rebalance (fewer wins per level), Stadium Lv50 band recalibrated to 620. Verified live: stats probe 87/87, wild battle + gym multi-turn, capture/save-load smoke, FULL 5-round Stadium clear (engine wins=1). Marker 'OTA v4'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass B: battle UI rebuilt to the Champions plate standard - status plates are static (foe top-right, ally left) and can never overlap a battler (art measured per bitmap and fit-capped; tallest roster art verified live), EXP row fully inside the ally plate, plates and battlers stay above MZ's opaque battle-window band at all times; HP shows as bar + PERCENTAGE on both sides, raw HP numbers removed everywhere in battle (incl. switch window); long species names shrink-to-fit instead of sliding under the type badge. Battle FX: type-colored impact bursts (bigger on KO), foe shake + red-flash hit reaction, player-side damage popups (stock MZ never renders them in front view), sink-and-fade player KO. Overworld camera zoom 1.5x with corrected touch mapping (perf-neutral on the rig: FPS ratio 0.93-1.00). Stadium party restore now returns members at true full HP (was 90%). js/ota.js restored to the bundle (missing from v3/v4 bundles). Verified: rig2 ship gate PASS 27/27, p2b live suite 18/18, unit suites FR1 10/10, FR2 11/11, P2A 5/5, P2B 13/13. Marker 'OTA v5'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass C: engine-side area encounters - all 10 encounter areas now roll their own designed tables (two-stage rarity: tier roll Common/Uncommon/Rare/Mythic with a quiet re-roll, then weighted species) instead of the legacy game-wide species 1-12 clamp. Route 1 is the gentlest area in the game: encounter step 12 -> 42 (fewest battles) and the softest fights (levels capped 2-5, stage-1 species only). Evolution-stage gating: every species is staged from its evolution chain (224 stage-1 / 176 stage-2 / 104 stage-3); each area has a max-stage gate so opening areas draw only base forms and evolved forms unlock by area depth (the per-area Mythic slot is a designer signature sighting; Route 1's mythic was swapped to a stage-1 species per the gating rule). Radiant Wanderer: a 1-in-10,000 Solgoddess (Lv 40) can replace a Route of Radiance (Map023) roll once you hold 4+ badges. Follower fix: the follower now always renders the lead's OWN walk sheet - Bubblix, Florabit and Bunspark had stale pre-rename sheets pointing at different creatures (Aquafox/Leafpup/Sparklet); all three sheets were regenerated from their own battlers and their data records corrected; the resolver can never silently substitute a wrong/generic sheet again (a missing sheet logs an exclusion instead). Verified: rig2 p2c live suite 11/11 (4,000-roll distribution, real Scene_Map trigger, all 9 starter-line followers sheet+bitmap), unit suites 53/53 (FR1 10, FR2 11, P2A 5, P2B 13, P2C 14), ship gate 26/27 with the one miss (smoke capture) re-run standalone at 8/8 - a throttled-rig timeout, documented in the Pass 2 report. Marker 'OTA v6'.

Starter-area provenance bundle: every remaining stock RPG Maker RTP asset visible in Wakaba Town, Prof. Kusu's Lab and Route 1 has been replaced with original art, verified in game (byte-identical fetch from the running game plus on-screen bitmap identity). 10 files swapped, nothing else: Prof. Kusu's intro portrait (img/pictures/People4_6.png, newly generated from our own Prof. Kusu master), the intro legendary Grimmorth (img/enemies/Goddess_of_death.png, now our own Ganjuko_Grimmorth art), the window skin on every dialogue box and menu (img/system/Window.png, original astral skin), the game-over screen (img/system/GameOver.png), follower emotion balloons (img/system/Balloon.png), touch-UI buttons (img/system/ButtonSet.png), chest / crystal / object sprite sheets (img/characters/!Chest.png, !Crystal.png, !Other1.png), and IconSet.png (the 11 cells visible in the starter stretch redrawn as original glyphs: 8 skill icons + capture Orb, Great Orb and Oran Berry item icons; a full-sheet redraw remains scheduled before the open-source release). Engine and species data are UNCHANGED from 2026.11.01-6 (engine md5 c5903fcd..., species md5 a56ee99a...); the bundle was verified file-by-file against the v6 bundle - exactly these 10 files plus the version marker differ. Marker 'OTA v7'.

Route enlargement bundle: Routes 4-8 (data/Map015.json, Map017.json, Map019.json, Map021.json, Map023.json) grow from empty 25x20 fields to 44x30 maps with real terrain for the first time - pine borders, a gate wall at the old east edge with a reachable far-side region beyond it, bent corridors, southern valleys, and per-route character (Route 4 deep forest, Route 5 scorched dirt road, Route 6 S-bend ridge, Route 7 canopy mire, Route 8 astral plateau with the Master Orb nook). No event was moved (every event keeps its exact coordinates and JSON), and encounter pacing is unchanged (encounterStep 30, per-area multiplier 1.0). Reachability was proven by two independent BFS implementations (offline + in-engine, zero orphan cells, every event reachable) and real held-key walks entry-to-exit on all five routes. Engine and species data are UNCHANGED from 2026.11.01-7 (engine md5 c5903fcd..., species md5 a56ee99a...); the bundle was verified file-by-file against the v7 bundle - exactly these 5 map files plus the version marker differ (7 entries). Marker 'OTA v8'.

Pass 3: tutorial-through-gameplay + identity fix. The opening now teaches through play: a new game's FIRST battle (whichever battle comes first - the trigger is save state, not an event) carries short in-battle coaching in Professor Kusu's voice (choosing a move, what the HP % means, a type-effectiveness note on your own first hit), dismissible with OK and skippable with cancel, and it can never fire twice on a save. After that the game leaves you alone until Route 1, where your first wild encounter after the guided battle becomes a capture lesson: the gentlest legal target from Route 1's own table (Galewing, Lv2, catchRate 220), the real Orb system and your real inventory (3 Orbs granted only if you hold none), weaken-first coaching, and encouragement if an Orb breaks free; the lesson completes on the catch and re-arms harmlessly on a KO, escape, or defeat, so it can never soft-lock. Progressed saves without the tutorial flag are never retro-tutorialized. IDENTITY FIX: the Lab specimens and the intro showcase showed pilot-era 'Aquafox'/'Leafpup' - they now show Bubblix and Florabit with their real art and names (engine showcase + data/Map002.json). The same fix repaired the Lab orb events, which handed out the WRONG species (the Bubblix orb gave Pyroclysm, the Florabit orb gave Leviatide, and rival Haru's counter-picks were likewise wrong) - orb picks and counter-picks now match their labels. Species data unchanged (md5 a56ee99a...). Bundle verified file-by-file against 2026.11.01-8: exactly the engine, Map002, and the version-marker files differ (4 entries). Marker 'OTA v9'.

Section 18 — Hidden Depth: the level cap rises to 100 (class tables extended at boot; a live Lv100 battle runs clean), and every Ganjuko now carries a hidden individual profile — inner potential, quiet training growth, a personality trait, and a bond that grows as you travel, battle, and earn badges together. None of it is ever shown as numbers: the rebuilt Character Sheet (party menu → Summary) tells you who your partner IS — a flavour profile, its temperament, hearts for closeness, final stats only — and at the Ganjuko League Champions Hall, the Listener will listen to one of your partners and speak of its gift, if you wear all eight badges. Breeding deepens too: daycare offspring now inherit from both parents (deposit-time snapshots). And keep an eye out: one wild Ganjuko in 1024 is a CHROMA — impossibly coloured, marked with a gold star in battle and a tag in your Dex. Species data unchanged (md5 a56ee99a...). Bundle verified file-by-file against 2026.11.01-9: exactly the engine, Map026 (the Listener's hall), and the version-marker files differ (4 entries). Marker 'OTA v10'.

Section 19 — the Battle Arena opens in the Champions Hall (Map026, Arena Desk beside Nurse Momo and the Listener). OFFLINE ARENA: build your team ONLY from your own save — your party and PC Box, never imported — and register up to six. Two formats at natural levels, no scaling: SINGLES (bring 6, pick 3) and true DOUBLES (bring 6, pick 4 — two active battlers per side, per-slot targeting, spread moves strike both opposing slots at reduced power, per-slot switch and KO replacement). TRIAL PARTNERS: fifteen designed partner builds across the five level bands (Sprout to Masters) rent for 50 Arena Points a set — rent the same build across five sets and recruit it permanently for 500 AP. Ten Trial Pilots field honest generated teams for sparring in your band. Champions timers run every Arena battle: 20 minutes total, 7 minutes of your time, 45 seconds a turn — a timeout makes your partner act on instinct, three in a row forfeits, and the clock decides finished battles on who's still standing. Arena battles grant no EXP and no quiet training growth (your whole party is restored whole afterwards, Stadium rules), but winning deepens your bond with the partners you fielded. HP everywhere — preview, picks, plates — is bar + percentage only, as always. Species data unchanged (md5 a56ee99a...). Bundle verified file-by-file against 2026.11.01-10: exactly the engine, Map026 (the Arena Desk), index.html and the version marker differ. Marker 'OTA v11'. Ship gate 26/27 — smoke.wildBattleWin waived by Rene 2026-11-02 (deterministic rig timeout, fails identically on the pre-Arena engine; all other 26 checks green; Arena live-verified separately).

Fix Round 3 — nine playtest fixes from Rene's phone sessions. READABLE TEXT AT LAST: the window skin never painted MZ's text palette, so dialogue and tutorial text rendered black-on-dark; the palette is repainted (white normal text), and the asset generator is patched so it survives regeneration. TRAINER LINE-OF-SIGHT BATTLES: ten route trainers now spot you crossing their facing line (range 5, line-of-sight), call out, and walk up into battle — no more talk-to-fight; one new trainer added on each of Routes 4-8. WALK SPEED FIXED AT THE ROOT: a plugin's dash branch had silently overridden the engine's whole speed model and made Always-Dash the default (7.5 tiles/s); walk is 2.65 t/s again, dash 5.3, Running Shoes 7.5, Mach Bike 8.9. BATTLE WINDOWS UNTANGLED: while a Pass 3 coach line shows, it is the only text surface — the stacked command/message/gold windows and the touch cancel chip hide and restore cleanly. OPENING FLOW: leaving Wakaba Town without a partner now brings Professor Kusu running up in person (the disembodied voice is gone) to send you to his Lab, and each starter orb shows the creature's picture for confirmation before it joins you. OPENING STATS AUDITED: 357 probe checks against the unified formula — no outliers, nothing in the opening carries inflated stats. ROUTE 2's mythic encounter is now the stage-2 Tidemanefang instead of its stage-3 evolution. BATTLE SYSTEM BUFF + MOVE INFO: Giga Drain and Soul Drain actually drain now, Twin Needle hits twice, Will-o-Wisp can burn, 23 moves gained real accuracy tiers (85/90/95), twelve species' signature moves — previously learned by nobody — are wired to their species, the duplicate Tackle is resolved, and the battle skill list now shows a Champions-style info line (type, power and accuracy derived live from the move's own data, plus effect text: drains, hits, status chances, buffs). WALL-WALKING CLOSED: 464 reachable wall/roof cells across 7 interior maps (Lab, Center & Mart, three gyms, Obsidian Cavern, Battle Tower) are blocked with invisible tiles — no tileset change; a full BFS re-audit reads zero. Species data changes are ONLY the D17 learnset wiring (GanjukoSpecies.json md5 9ed00815...). AND THE LAST STOCK ART IS GONE: the icon sheet is now a full original redraw (all 320 cells), closing the provenance sweep — every visible asset in the game is ours. Everything else — the Arena, Section 18 genetics, the type chart — is untouched: bundle verified file-by-file against 2026.11.01-11, exactly 24 entries differ (22 changed + the two new starter pictures). Marker 'OTA v12'.
